messages.text: I can't found my username and order...

I found it from the email you gave, so you don't need a username. There's no login on our store. Your order is Shop···· from August 16. It's a Magic M. 40T with the Power K. and Miner D., it's paid, and it hasn't shipped yet.

Magic M. expects the units to leave the factory on November 12. We'll email you the tracking as soon as your miner ships.

We sent you updates on November 3 and November 8. If you can't find them, check your spam folder. Is there anything you'd like to know about the order?
Oh... My life changed a lot, I'm staying outside... I need to cancel my order and get a refund. Is it possible?
Handed to the team · Rule 39 hold done. Refund decision needs a person if they turn down the alternat

I'm sorry to hear things have changed so much. I've paused your order, so nothing will ship while we work this out.

Your Magic M. is already being built for you and leaves the factory on November 12. If you've moved, we can probably send it to your new address instead. Where are you living now?

If you'd rather not have the miner at all, we can keep the full $1,238 as store credit for anything else in the store. I've also let the team know about your request, so they're following this chat.
OK, but I really prefer to get a refund if possible, I will have no way to mine anything for long, I'm homeless for the moment.
Handed to the team · This replaces my earlier "don't refund yet" note. The customer has made a final,

I'm really sorry you're going through this. I won't push you to keep the order.

I can't issue refunds myself, so I've passed your refund request to a supervisor, along with your situation. Your order stays paused, so nothing will ship in the meantime.

If you can, stay in this chat, because someone from the team may jump in here. If you have to go, they'll reply to (email hidden) You don't need to send anything else.
You're welcome. Your request is with the team, and the order stays paused until they reply. I hope things get easier for you soon. Take care.
